$comment: L0-WP09 feature-flag table (planset 2026-11-07-v060, lanes/L0_INTEGRATION_SEAMS.md section 5). One row per build-time flag: a bool const marked with a '// @flag' line right above it.

default is the const's value in the code. signoff names the record a true value needs: release/signoffs/<id>.json, verified against release/signoffs/signers.json and the packet copy <id>_SIGNOFF_PACKET.md (owner and security lead, EIP-191). gate names a test in the flag's file that gates a change. Every row has at least one.

src-tauri/src/flags_tests.rs ties this table to the code both ways and runs the sign-off check; src/shell/flags.gen.ts is generated from it by scripts/gen-flags.mjs. A flag never defaults on a feature whose data source does not exist (Rule 1).
A sign-off record for a security-sensitive item holds only a hash of a private packet, never the findings.

flags.name: HERMES_NODE_WRITE_TOOLS
flags.summary: Hermes is offered the node MCP server's write tools (proposals the member approves in the app).

flags.name: TRANSPORT_SIGNED_OFF
flags.summary: The CL-S4 cross-machine transport sign-off is recorded in this build (one of the two preconditions for the mesh on by default).

flags.name: MULTI_GROUP_DAEMON
flags.summary: The bundled cluster daemon serves every group from one process (checked against the pinned daemon rev).
